summary: The proposed patch addresses the inconsistency in the `world_to_pixel` method of `SlicedLowLevelWCS` by ensuring that the correct default values are used for sliced-out dimensions.

issues.description: The approach uses hardcoded default values (`0.`) for sliced-out dimensions, which may not be appropriate for all cases. A more flexible solution that considers the actual default values from the WCS might be preferable.
